Interface Node

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseAgent, BaseNode, JoinNode, LlmAgent, LoopAgent, ParallelAgent, PlannerAgent, RemoteA2AAgent, SequentialAgent, Start, Workflow
public interface Node
A unit of work in a workflow graph. Node names must be unique within a graph. Every member except name() and description() is experimental, so implementing this interface is too.

    • outputSchema

      @Experimental default Optional<com.google.genai.types.Schema> outputSchema()
      Returns the schema that the node's output value must match. The content of a message-as-output event is not checked against this schema.

    • stateSchema

      @Experimental default Optional<com.google.genai.types.Schema> stateSchema()
      Returns the schema declaring the state keys the node uses. Child nodes inherit it unless they declare their own.

    • requiresAllPredecessors

      @Experimental default boolean requiresAllPredecessors()
      Returns true if the node runs only once every predecessor has completed, receiving all their outputs keyed by node name, as a fan-in node does.

    • runNode

      @Experimental io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Flowable<?> runNode(Context context, @Nullable Object nodeInput)
      Runs the node on nodeInput, the output it receives from its predecessors.

      An emitted Event passes through, and any other emitted value becomes the node's output (at most one per run); emit nothing for no output, since RxJava forbids null. The wildcard lets an implementation return a Flowable of its own type.
